headline.title: Beating Beta — 9 Jun 2026
headline.summary: Guru pair: Ray Dalio (defensive) vs. Michael Burry (bearish on AI momentum). Chip rebound +7%. CPI trigger day.

stories.title: Ray Dalio & Michael Burry: Defensive vs. Contrarian
stories.toc_summary: Dalio warns AI bubble; Burry holds PLTR/NVDA shorts. Market on narrow base.
stories.quick_take:
Ray Dalio (Bridgewater) — DEFENSIVE: AI valuation bubble + rising yields (4.57%) confirm All-Weather thesis. Bullish: Gold, non-US, bonds. Bearish: US Tech megacaps.

Michael Burry (Scion) — BEARISH on AI momentum: PLTR $912M puts + NVDA $186M puts. Chip rebound tests thesis. Bullish: EL, LULU, REGN.

bullets.label: Ray Dalio
bullets.text: All-Weather Portfolio — Gold, EM, Bonds. Bearish on concentrated US Tech. Gold at $4,330 = hedge working.

bullets.label: Michael Burry
bullets.text: Short PLTR ($912M puts) + NVDA ($186M puts). Contrarian long: EL, LULU, REGN.

bullets.label: Consensus
bullets.text: Market on narrow foundation. Watch CPI Jun 10.
